svg.title: Bean • a gauge-correct knitting chart for a cup cosy
svg.desc: A two-colour chart with a diagonal coffee bean repeated every 20 stitches over 24 rounds. Rectangular cells reflect a gauge of 24 stitches and 32 rounds per 10 centimetres. Cast on 60 stitches and repeat the boxed motif three times in the round.
svg.text: Two colours. Three repeats. A small daily ritual.
Start at lower right. Read every round right to left; work upwards from round 1.
one stitch is wider than one row.
so the beans knit as tilted ovals.
Cast on 60 sts; join in the round.
In A: 4 rounds of k1, p1 rib.
In A: 4 rounds of k1, p1 rib.
Bind off elastically; weave in ends.
For a handleless cup, ~27 cm around.
